builds.title: Dam guard with 8 giant HD
builds.difficulty: CR 5 as the racial-only printed benchmark. ECL 11 with level adjustment +3.
traits: Lawful neutral. BAB +6, grapple +23 with Improved Grapple, 10-ft. space/reach. Fort +11, Ref +3, Will +3.
Touch 9, flat-footed 20. Spiked half-plate +7, spiked heavy shield +2, natural armor +2, Large −1. Half-plate has a +0 Dexterity cap.
Weapon Focus (morningstar), Power Attack, Improved Shield Bash, Improved Grapple (bonus), Two-Weapon Fighting (bonus). Armor spikes add 1d8 piercing to a successful grapple check to deal damage.
actions: Morningstar +15 melee, 2d6+9 piercing and bludgeoning. Full attack +15/+10.

Shield spike +14 melee, 1d8+9 piercing as the sole weapon. When he full-attacks with both weapons, morningstar +11/+6 and shield spike +10 with 1d8+4 off-hand damage. Improved Shield Bash retains his shield bonus.
Rock +7 ranged, 2d6+9 bludgeoning. Increment 100 ft., maximum 500 ft.
builds.tactics: Brann stays behind the gate and uses his reach to stop anyone forcing their way in. He throws from cover if someone crosses the exposed dam.

builds.title: Shadow broker with 11 outsider HD
builds.difficulty: CR 11 as the racial-only printed benchmark. ECL 16 with level adjustment +5.
traits: Lawful evil. BAB +11, grapple +13, 5-ft. space/reach. Fort +12, Ref +14, Will +8.

Touch 16. Normally retains AC 25 when flat-footed because of uncanny dodge. AC 19 when Dexterity is denied. Mithral shirt contributes +4 armor and caps the AC bonus at +6 Dexterity. It has no armor check penalty.
Improved evasion gives half damage on a failed Reflex save against an effect that allows half damage. Cannot be flanked except by a rogue of level 15 or higher.
DR 15/good and piercing. SR 21. Weapon Finesse, Weapon Focus (claw), Improved Initiative, Blind-Fight.
Sneak Attack +6d6 on hits against a target who is denied Dexterity to AC or flanked by Sahir. No bonus against targets with concealment or immune to critical hits.
actions: Claw +19 melee, 1d4+2 slashing. Full attack makes two claws at +19 each. Racial sneak attack can apply to both.

Detect Thoughts (Su), continuous, CL 18. Suppress or resume as a free action. At stage 3, read surface thoughts within a 60-ft. cone on a failed Will DC 16. A successful save blocks that target for this use.

Change Shape (Su), standard action. His preferred disguise is a Medium human clerk. He loses the claw attacks, keeps his other defenses, and can maintain the guise indefinitely. Disguise is +29 with the form or +33 while reading the observer’s mind. Add +2 from Bluff synergy when acting in character.
Shadow Jump (Su), standard action like dimension door. One 20-ft. or two 10-ft. jumps per day, starting and ending in shadow. No more actions after a jump that turn.
Hide in Plain Sight (Su). Hide while observed within 10 ft. of a shadow other than his own. Use the normal action rules for Hide.
builds.tactics: Sahir listens in a human guise. If cornered, he changes back, waits until the strongest guard is distracted, and withdraws into shadow after getting what he came for.

builds.title: Quarry watch with 10 giant HD
builds.difficulty: CR 7 as the racial-only printed benchmark. ECL 15 with level adjustment +5.
traits: Chaotic neutral. Touch 12, flat-footed 16. BAB +7, grapple +18, 10-ft. space/reach. Fort +14, Ref +6, Will +5.

Immune to acid. Regeneration 5 converts damage except sonic to nonlethal. Sonic damage deals 150% of the rolled amount and remains lethal. Scent detects nearby creatures, with wind affecting its range.
Weapon Focus (claw), Multiattack, Iron Will, Alertness.
actions: Claw +14 melee, 1d6+7 slashing.
Full attack. Two claws +14 melee, 1d6+7 each, and bite +11 melee, 1d6+3 piercing. If both claws hit the same target, rend that target for 2d6+10 additional damage.
builds.tactics: Hrak uses his reach to keep intruders off the ledge. He backs away from direct sonic damage and closes on anyone who stays within reach.

builds.title: Toll keeper, Ogre Mage class tier 4
builds.difficulty: CR 2 by Table A–39. ECL 4 with 3 HD.
traits: Lawful neutral. Touch 11, flat-footed 15. Studded leather +3, natural armor +2, Dex +1. BAB +2, grapple +6, 5-ft. face and reach. Fort +5, Ref +2, Will +2.
Improved Initiative and Weapon Focus (shortspear). Original 3.0 shortspear is a Medium weapon. Holding it in both hands gives 1½ × Strength damage.
Spell-like abilities are CL 7, one use of each per day. Target spell resistance applies to charm person and sleep. Novak has neither regeneration nor spell resistance at this tier.
actions: Shortspear +7 melee, 1d8+6 piercing when used two-handed, critical ×3. Thrown +4 ranged, 1d8+4 piercing, 20-ft. increment.

Charm person (Sp), standard action. One humanoid of Medium size or smaller within 40 ft., Will DC 14. Treats Novak as a trusted friend for 7 hours. +5 on the save if Novak or his allies threaten the target. Threats by Novak or his allies end the charm.

Sleep (Sp), standard action. Choose a point within 170 ft. Roll 2d4 total HD, and affect living creatures in its 15-ft. radius, lowest HD first and closest among ties. Affected creatures must have fewer than 5 HD. Will DC 14 or helpless sleep for 7 minutes, ending if slapped awake or wounded.
Darkness (Sp), standard action. An object touched radiates magical darkness in a 20-ft. radius for 70 minutes. Standard illumination and darkvision fail inside.
Invisibility (Sp), standard action, touch. Target and its gear turn invisible for 70 minutes or until the target attacks. Novak normally uses it on himself.
Flight (Su). Resume or stop flight as a free action. Use ordinary movement for flying at 40 ft. with good maneuverability.
builds.tactics: Novak first tries to bargain. When attacked, he uses sleep on the weakest opponents and flies away from the rest. He keeps darkness for blocking pursuit.

builds.title: Courier, Sorcerer 1
builds.difficulty: CR 1 by class as a baseline, with Change Shape and racial spell-like abilities. ECL 3 with level adjustment +2.
traits: Lawful good. Touch 12, flat-footed 10. BAB +0, grapple −1, 5-ft. space and reach. Fort +0, Ref +2, Will +2. Improved Initiative.

Sorcerer 1, caster level 1. Spells per day: five 0-level, four 1st-level (including one bonus slot). Known cantrips are message, prestidigitation, ray of frost, and read magic. Known 1st-level spells are mage armor and magic missile. No familiar is present.
actions: Dagger −1 melee or +2 thrown, 1d4−1 damage (minimum 1), 19–20/×2, 10-ft. range increment.
Mage Armor. Standard action, touch, duration 1 hour. In true or borrowed form it adds +4 armor to Serein’s AC, giving AC 16.
Magic Missile. Standard action. One dart for 1d4+1 force damage within 110 ft. No save. Spell resistance applies.
Ray of Frost. Standard action. +2 ranged touch out to 25 ft., 1d3 cold damage. No save. Spell resistance applies.

Change Shape (Su). Standard action, three uses per day. Her favorite form is a Medium human clerk, keeping the same scores, HP, saves, land speed and AC. She has Disguise +15 in this form. Revert freely in terms of uses.

Racial spell-like abilities. Each once per day at CL 1, DC 13 where a save applies: dancing lights, detect magic, flare, ghost sound, light, mage hand. Flare dazzles one living creature within 25 ft. for 1 minute on a failed Fortitude save. Ghost sound makes about four humans’ worth of noise within 25 ft., Will disbelief if interacted with.
builds.tactics: Serein keeps mage armor up during a risky delivery. She uses ghost sound to divert observers and leaves before her disguise is challenged.

concepts.name: Brann Gatewright
concepts.role: Gate engineer who guards a half-built dam.
concepts.motive: Keep the floodgates safe until the last stone is seated.
concepts.hook: One buttress lists in the rain. Brann has blocked the bridge, but will admit someone who can examine the masonry.

concepts.name: Sahir Inkveil
concepts.role: Broker who buys clues from the lighthouse watch.
concepts.motive: Learn who has altered the lights used as route signals.
concepts.hook: Sahir offers the party a harmless false lead to see where they take it.

concepts.name: Hrak Shard
concepts.role: Quarry watch who guards a sound-sensitive crossing.
concepts.motive: Drive off the people who keep testing their bells inside his home.
concepts.hook: A quarry bell lies smashed. Hrak wants the party to carry its clapper out of the valley.

concepts.name: Novak Siltspur
concepts.role: Toll keeper who guards a river crossing from above.
concepts.motive: Recover gate money a former partner hid upstream.
concepts.hook: Novak will waive a toll for anyone who helps trace two receipts signed by someone now missing.

concepts.name: Serein Ix
concepts.role: A quiet sorcerer who carries sealed letters under a borrowed face.
concepts.motive: Return a set of letters to their author while preserving the author’s privacy.
concepts.hook: Two people named in the letters claim to be the same person. Serein asks the party to witness a meeting.
